## Stages

Order follows your partner's progression (O1 → O2 → O3), which is also the dependency order: each outcome reads the previous one's output. All three outcomes reach a working first form on real data (Stages 1–3) before any hardening stage, so the measured costs from Stages 1 and 2 inform the hardening stages.

- [ ] Stage 1: Index files into one table
      Objective: Ingest real quarterly and daily master index files for a bounded range into one filing-index table.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: the workspace scaffold only
      Produces: a filing-index table on local disk, one row per filing, built from real SEC index files; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: for at least one real closed quarter plus the daily files of a later period, the table holds every row of the source files, with no duplicate filings where they overlap; the findings file records the measured wall time, bytes downloaded, row count and achieved request rate of that real run
      Leaves out: raw snapshot retention and replay, source manifest, checkpoint and resume, versioned quarter publication (Stage 4); daily catch-up and quarterly reconciliation (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submissions downloaded
      Objective: Download the individual submissions named by a bounded slice of the Stage 1 table's rows.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table
      Produces: submissions on local disk, each traceable to its index row; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: every submission in the chosen slice is on disk or listed as failed with its reason; the findings file records measured time and bytes per submission and the projected time and volume for the full history
      Leaves out: full-history download with checkpoint and resume, shared request budget across collectors (Stage 6); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick out the 10-K and 8-K filings among the downloaded submissions and extract each one's main document.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table; Stage 2's downloaded submissions
      Produces: the main document of each 10-K and 8-K in the slice, extracted and linked to its filing; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: for the Stage 2 slice, every 10-K and 8-K has its main document extracted or is listed with the reason it was not; the findings file records the extraction success rate and measured time
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Index ingestion hardening
      Objective: Make index ingestion replayable and resumable, with complete versioned publication.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table and specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Produces: raw snapshot retention and replay, source manifest, checkpoint and resume, versioned quarter publication for the index table
      Exit: a parser change rebuilds the table from retained source files with no SEC requests; an interrupted run resumes without redoing completed source files; readers see only complete quarter versions
      Leaves out: daily catch-up and quarterly reconciliation (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Index corrections over time
      Objective: Keep the index table current and correct as the SEC adds daily files and revises quarterly ones.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: Stage 4's source manifest and versioned quarter publication
      Produces: daily catch-up and quarterly reconciliation
      Exit: a run after missed days ingests every missed daily file, across quarter boundaries; re-reading a revised quarterly file records its additions and changes, and a removal does not leave the active table without approval
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Submissions at full history
      Objective: Download the submissions for the full requested history within one SEC request budget.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 2's downloader and specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md; Stage 4's checkpoint and resume
      Produces: full-history download with checkpoint and resume, shared request budget across collectors
      Exit: a full-history download interrupted midway resumes without re-downloading completed submissions; index and submission downloads running together never exceed the configured request rate; a report lists every submission not yet downloaded
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 7); scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

      Objective: Cover the historical formats and failure cases of all three outcomes with tests that run without SEC access.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 1–6
      Produces: full validation suite
      Exit: CI runs on committed fixtures covering the index formats across the supported range, malformed and HTML-error responses, and 10-K/8-K document layouts, and downloads nothing from the SEC
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 8)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 8: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion, reconciliation and submission downloads on a schedule in a deployed environment.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: Stages 4–7
      Produces: scheduling and deployment, with monitoring and runbooks
      Exit: scheduled daily and reconciliation runs complete in the deployed environment and their reports show source gaps; alerts fire on failed runs and on SEC access blocks
      Leaves out: nothing
